summary:
Radar for Oct 15, 2026, GLP-1 focus only. Verified with 12 searches and 1 failed fetch (Lilly's investor page returned 403).

Top opportunities:
1. **Bootleg "reta".** Two FDA death reports (unverified, cause unclear), and poison-center exposures rose 249 → 460 → 862 per quarter. CBS, NewsNation, Gizmodo and MedPage all picked it up between Oct 13 and 15. This fits our proven myth-bust format (online "retatrutide" Short got 56 views).
2. **Orforglipron (Foundayo) vs the semaglutide pill.** A new Lilly indirect comparison adds to the ACHIEVE-3 head-to-head (Lancet). It fits the "Did X beat Y?" title that gave us our breakout.
3. **Retatrutide TRIUMPH-2.** Search interest should peak around Lilly's Oct 29 earnings.
4. **GLP-1s and slower aging.** Novo and Lilly epigenetic-clock data, CNN and NewsNation coverage, and a mouse study in Nature. Hedge heavily.
5. **GLP-1s and schizophrenia.** Lancet Psychiatry, Oct 14: about 70,000 US records, 24% fewer psychiatric admissions in adults with schizophrenia plus type 2 diabetes. Observational. This is the earliest-stage story on the list.

Evergreen anchors:
- Protecting muscle on tirzepatide (our best performer).
- Keeping results after stopping.
- Cost changes coming Jan 2027.
- A calm "does Mounjaro affect your eyes?" Short that pairs the NAION concern with tirzepatide's lower retinopathy link (both observational).

Cautions:
- **NAION vision loss is peaking on fear content.** Our safety-scare Shorts sit below median, so only cover it with a calm, practical angle.
- **Rejected:** needle-free tirzepatide patch hype and the CNN story on anorexia prescribing (eating-disorder guardrail).
- **Unverified:** the Bloomberg piece on Chinese compounding-ingredient plants. Use only the FDA's own warning letters.
- **Date every status:** Foundayo's approval date (I didn't verify it), retatrutide as investigational as of Oct 2026, and the EU Wegovy pill approval (July 2026, not October).

candidates.topic: Bootleg 'reta' (sold online as retatrutide): FDA logged 2 death reports and US poison-center exposures rose from 249 to 460 to 862 per quarter (Q1 to Q3 2026)
candidates.angle: Myth-bust: 'Online reta isn't Lilly's retatrutide.' Retatrutide is investigational as of Oct 2026 and not FDA approved. Black-market vials can contain the wrong amount of drug or contaminants (Lilly). The deaths are unverified, and it isn't known what was actually in the vials. Name no seller and give no buying or dosing details. Close by pointing to approved options through a prescriber.
candidates.predicted_peak: 2–7 days (more news hooks expected around Lilly's Oct 29 earnings)
candidates.why_now: CBS investigation (Oct 13), then NewsNation, Gizmodo, MedPage, Medical Daily, AJC (Georgia black market) and a law-firm alert on Lilly's lawsuits, all within 72 h. Search interest in 'reta' is surging alongside TRIUMPH-2. Our online 'retatrutide' Short got 56 views, above the GLP-1 median.

evidence.signal: Poison centers: 862 exposures in the quarter to September vs 460 and 249 before; FDA logged 2 death reports
Deaths unverified; unclear whether products were actually retatrutide
Mainstream tech/science pickup Oct 14
Original investigation, video

candidates.topic: Orforglipron (Foundayo) pill vs oral semaglutide: ACHIEVE-3 head-to-head in type 2 diabetes, plus Lilly's new indirect comparison against oral semaglutide 25 mg
candidates.angle: 'Did the orforglipron pill beat the semaglutide pill?' One number with its context. In ACHIEVE-3 (adults with type 2 diabetes), orforglipron's top dose gave about 9.2% weight loss vs about 5.3% for oral semaglutide 14 mg over about a year. The 25 mg comparison is an indirect (cross-trial) analysis that Lilly reported. Explain non-peptide vs peptide pills: orforglipron needs no fasting rule. Only semaglutide and orforglipron come as tablets; tirzepatide is injection only. Date the approval status.
candidates.why_now: Lilly's indirect-comparison press release and a Stocktwits story ('Foundayo beats Novo's oral semaglutide') on Oct 14. Medical News Today covered orforglipron and menopause (Oct 13). Rybelsus/Wegovy-pill searchers are a ready-made audience. This is our 'Did X beat Y' breakout format.

evidence.signal: Foundayo 17.2 mg showed greater weight loss and A1C reduction than oral semaglutide 25 mg in an indirect comparison (adults with T2D)
Pivotal T2D trials including the ACHIEVE-3 head-to-head vs oral semaglutide
Reports Foundayo is FDA approved for weight loss (check the date against FDA before scripting)
Orforglipron results by menopausal stage (Oct 13)

candidates.topic: Retatrutide TRIUMPH-2: 18.8% average weight loss (up to 20.8% at the top dose) at 80 weeks in adults with obesity and type 2 diabetes. What it is and when it might be available
candidates.angle: 'What is retatrutide, and when could you actually get it?' Explain the triple-hormone drug (GIP, GLP-1, glucagon). State the TRIUMPH-2 population and comparator: this trial was vs placebo, not vs tirzepatide. Add the status: investigational as of Oct 2026, with Lilly planning to file (per earlier reports, Q1 2027). Tie in a short warning that online 'reta' isn't the trial drug.
candidates.predicted_peak: Around Lilly Q3 earnings, Oct 29 (10–16 days)
candidates.why_now: Medical Xpress and Diabetes.co.uk (Oct 13–15), Yahoo explainer 'when could it be available', Forbes/Stocktwits on the CEO betting on retatrutide. Earnings on Oct 29 will refresh demand. This topic has appeared in 2 prior snapshots at 86–90.

evidence.signal: 18.8% average weight loss in Phase III T2D trial
Phase III TRIUMPH-2 coverage, Oct 13
Lilly earnings Oct 29: retatrutide is the key story

candidates.topic: Do semaglutide and tirzepatide slow aging? Novo and Lilly epigenetic-clock data (about 2–3 years slower biological aging reported) plus an NIH-funded mouse lifespan study
candidates.angle: 'Does Mounjaro or Ozempic slow aging? What an epigenetic clock can and can't tell you.' Separate the company-reported clock analyses in trial participants with diabetes or overweight, the mouse lifespan data (Nature, older female mice), and proven outcomes (SELECT cardiovascular events in adults with heart disease and overweight/obesity). Be clear that it's too early to take these drugs to live longer. Use no #antiaging-style claims.
candidates.why_now: CNN 'Could GLP-1 drugs be anti-aging medications?' (Oct 13), NewsNation, KENS5 'could lengthen lives' (Oct 15), Washington Post 'most interesting side effects' (Oct 15). Coverage is now moving from mainstream outlets to creators.

evidence.signal: Novo and Lilly data: epigenetic clocks suggest slower aging of about 2–3 years
Semaglutide extended lifespan in aging mice (Nature); human relevance unknown
Drugmakers say their medication could lengthen lives (Oct 15)

candidates.topic: GLP-1 medicines and schizophrenia: Lancet Psychiatry study of about 70,000 US adults with schizophrenia and type 2 diabetes found GLP-1 starters had 24% lower risk of psychiatric admission and 29% lower risk of mental-health ER visits
candidates.angle: Benefits beyond weight, explained with care: 'linked to', not 'treats'. The study is observational, in people who have both schizophrenia and type 2 diabetes. Note the earlier Swedish registry signal for depression and anxiety. Add 'don't stop or change your current medicines on your own' and the prescriber line. Give an absolute rate if the paper reports one.
candidates.why_now: Published Oct 14 (Lancet Psychiatry). Bloomberg, pharmaphorum, Quartz and a Science Media Centre expert reaction within 24 h. Health creators haven't covered it yet. Mood and GLP-1 is a recurring question.

evidence.signal: 24% less likely to be admitted, 29% less likely to visit the ER for a mental-health crisis
Expert reaction: interpret cautiously, observational
Observational EHR cohort, adults with schizophrenia and T2D

candidates.topic: How to protect muscle on tirzepatide (Mounjaro/Zepbound): what the SURMOUNT-1 body-scan substudy shows, plus protein and strength training (refreshed by the 'mistake specialists see' and muscle-sparing drug news)
candidates.angle: Our best-performing GLP-1 lane. 'Does tirzepatide burn fat or muscle?' Give the SURMOUNT-1 DXA substudy (obesity, or overweight with a weight-related condition, without diabetes). Then two practical habits: protein (check first if you have kidney disease) and strength training (start gently). These are recommended habits, not proven to protect muscle on tirzepatide. Muscle-sparing add-on drugs (e.g. an activin E antibody in primates) are early research only.
keywords: how to keep muscle on ozempic
candidates.predicted_peak: Steady; the Jan 1 resolution season boosts it
candidates.why_now: Statesman Journal 'mistake diabetes specialists see after people start GLP-1 meds' (Oct 14), BioPharm on IBIO-610 shifting semaglutide loss toward fat in primates (Oct 13), and the Carousel→Short conversion recommended in the playbook.

evidence.signal: Common mistake after starting GLP-1s
Activin E antibody shifts weight loss toward fat in primates (preclinical)

candidates.topic: What happens after stopping a GLP-1? STEP 1 extension and SURMOUNT-4 regain data, plus a new pilot RCT where a coaching app or medically tailored meals cut 4-month regain from about 10.75% to about 3.6%
candidates.angle: 'Will the weight come back if you stop Zepbound or Wegovy?' State each trial's exact population. The pilot RCT is small, and the meals were medically tailored. End on which habits help, with no stopping or switching advice and the prescriber line.
keywords: what happens when you stop mounjaro
candidates.predicted_peak: Steady; spikes with the Jan 2027 price and coverage changes
candidates.why_now: Medical News Today 'best ways to maintain results' (Oct 14), Business Insider dietitian 'not a free lunch' (Oct 14), and the Obes Sci Pract pilot RCT (Oct 7). Coverage changes on Jan 1 push people to plan.

evidence.signal: Pilot RCT on preventing regain after GLP-1 discontinuation
Maintaining results with GLP-1s

candidates.topic: GLP-1 costs change Jan 1, 2027: Ozempic and Wegovy US list prices cut up to 50%, Walmart offers $0 GLP-1s to employees with type 2 diabetes (with prior authorization), and Medicare's GLP-1 options
candidates.angle: 'Will Ozempic or Wegovy cost less in 2027? What actually changes.' A practical explainer of list price vs what you pay. Walmart's $0 coverage applies to employees with type 2 diabetes only. Close with questions to ask your insurer and prescriber. Use no brand-as-ad framing and no compounded alternatives.
candidates.why_now: Novo price-cut coverage (Oct 13–14), Walmart benefits news (Oct 13–14, Fox Business), 'does medicare pay for weight loss drugs' queries. Open enrollment season is running now.

evidence.signal: Walmart: some GLP-1s free for employees with type 2 diabetes, with prior authorization, from 2027
Novo to cut Ozempic and Wegovy prices by up to 50%

candidates.topic: Does Mounjaro affect your eyes? Tirzepatide linked to lower diabetic retinopathy risk (Ophthalmology, 86,923 per group), alongside the semaglutide NAION signal
candidates.angle: A calm 'what does it do to my body' question: 'Does tirzepatide affect your eyes?' Both findings are observational. Tirzepatide was linked to lower 12-month diabetic retinopathy risk vs lifestyle alone (86,923 matched adults per group with diabetes and overweight/obesity). NAION is a rare, debated signal mainly studied with semaglutide. Practical step: keep up regular eye exams and report sudden vision changes promptly. Prescriber line.
candidates.predicted_peak: Now to 5 days (NAION news peak); the eye question is evergreen
candidates.why_now: ScienceDaily 'Ozempic and Wegovy linked to rare risk of sudden vision loss' (Oct 15), Fox News 'went blind' story (Oct 15), Korean safety coverage, and Medical Economics resurfacing the tirzepatide retinopathy finding (Oct 14). Safety-scare framing underperforms for us; the balanced 'what does it do to my eyes' question fits our winners.

evidence.signal: Ozempic/Wegovy linked to rare sudden vision loss (Oct 15)
Tirzepatide linked to lower risk of diabetic eye disease (observational)
Tirzepatide associated with lower DR progression and treatment

candidates.topic: Semaglutide and asthma/COPD flare-ups: UK records study (ERS 2026, not yet peer reviewed) linked semaglutide to about 40% fewer asthma attacks and about 20% fewer COPD exacerbations vs other diabetes drugs
candidates.angle: Benefits beyond weight, at an early stage: 'Could semaglutide mean fewer asthma attacks?' The study is observational, in people on diabetes treatment, presented at a congress and not yet peer reviewed. No off-label suggestions. Keep using your inhalers and plan with your clinician.
candidates.why_now: Hospital Pharmacy Europe resurfaced the finding Oct 15. The September ERS abstract has had little consumer or creator coverage. Low competition.

evidence.signal: Semaglutide linked to fewer asthma and COPD exacerbations
80,000+ UK patients; semaglutide cohort 22,537; not peer reviewed

candidates.topic: Eloralintide plus tirzepatide (amylin combo): up to 23.3% weight loss at 48 weeks in adults with obesity and type 2 diabetes (Phase 2b, n=367), but 10.8–27% stopped for side effects vs 2.9% on tirzepatide alone
candidates.angle: Follow-up to our breakout long-form: 'Is more weight loss worth more side effects? The amylin + tirzepatide trade-off.' Credit the figures to Lilly or the EASD presentation, name the dose arms, and note the expected timelines are analyst estimates. Investigational as of Oct 2026.
candidates.why_now: Drug Discovery News 'Lilly's amylin combo raises the bar' (Oct 15). Our EloraTZP long-form is still growing (322 views), so a Short that sends viewers to it is low-risk. Only link it once it's confirmed published.

evidence.signal: Adding amylin agonist to tirzepatide increased weight loss in T2D
Up to 23.3% weight loss in adults with obesity and T2D

candidates.angle: A myth-bust in the format of our 56-view Short: 'Is cheap online semaglutide the same as Ozempic?' Cite the FDA's own warning letters and Q&A on unapproved GLP-1s. Name no sellers and give no buying routes. Point people to a prescriber and licensed pharmacies.

candidates.angle: 'Wegovy pill or shot: what's actually different?' Cover how it's taken, the trial results by formulation and population, and common side effects. The US approval was Dec 22, 2025; the EU approval was July 2026. Builds on our semaglutide-pill Short (52 Instagram reach in 1 day).

EU authorised the Wegovy pill (announced July 2026)
